faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: FAQ – QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
faq.description: Everything you need to know about your construction and garden design projects – transparent and understandable.
faq.question1: How does the planning process at LANDSTARKBAU work?
faq.answer1: The planning process begins with a non-binding consultation on site, where we analyze your wishes and ideas. Then we create an initial concept, which we discuss and refine with you. After the final planning and cost estimate, our experienced team begins implementation.
faq.question2: How long does it take to implement a construction or landscaping project?
faq.answer2: The construction time depends on the size and complexity of the project. An average project (300-500 sqm) is realized in about 4-8 weeks. For more complex projects with terraces, walls or water features, the construction time can be 12-16 weeks.
faq.question3: How much does professional construction or garden design cost?
faq.answer3: Costs vary depending on size, design and materials. A simple project can be realized from 5,000 €, while elaborate projects with terraces, high-quality planting and special building elements can cost 30,000 € or more. We will be happy to provide you with an individual offer.
faq.question4: Do you also take care of maintenance and upkeep?
faq.answer4: Yes, we offer a comprehensive care service. From regular lawn care and hedge trimming to seasonal planting and cleaning – our team takes care of your project all year round.
faq.question5: Are there funding opportunities for construction and garden projects?
faq.answer5: Yes, for certain measures such as green roofs, rainwater harvesting or natural gardens, there are funding programs from municipalities, federal states or KfW. We will be happy to advise you on possible funding and assist you with the application process.
faq.question6: Can I have only parts of my property designed?
faq.answer6: Of course! We realize both complete new installations and partial areas such as terraces, driveways, fences, rock gardens or individual planting concepts. We will be happy to create an offer for your desired area.
faq.moreQuestions: Do you have more questions? We are here for you!
